item.title: Quebec auto board lied about cost overruns for online platform, inquiry finds
item.description: QUÉBEC — Quebec's automobile insurance board lied to the provincial government to conceal exploding costs in the creation of the agency's online platform, says a public inquiry into the cost-overrun scandal.

item.title: Ottawa says national security incident, error at emergency stockpile unrelated
item.description: OTTAWA — There was no connection between a national security incident at the country's emergency stockpile warehouse in 2024 and an error that caused the loss of $20-million of medication, according to the Public Health Agency of Canada.
